# **Overview** {#overview}

1. **IP Whitelist**  
     
   To integrate FlyPay API, kindly provide server outgoing IP to FlyPay Tech team for whitelisting purpose  
   FlyPay IP: 43.208.13.198  
     
     
2. **Setup RSA Key**  
     
   There are two sets of RSA Key required for FlyPay Integration which are Merchant RSA Key and FlyPay RSA Key.  
     
   Merchant RSA Key  
   Generated by Merchant, required to pass Merchant Public Key to FlyPay Tech Team to upload in FlyPay Back Office.  
     
   FlyPay RSA Key  
   Generated by FlyPay, will provide FlyPay Public Key to Merchant for integration purpose.  
     
     
3. **AES Key**  
     
   AES Key generated by FlyPay, will provide AES Key to Merchant for integration purpose.  
     
   AES Encryption & Decryption: Refer [AES Method](#1.10.-aes-method)  
     
     
4. **Signature**  
   Signature will be used by RSA Method with SHA1 hash algorithm.  
     
     
     
5. **API Domain**  
   Production environment: flypay.site  
   

   # **Deposit API** {#deposit-api}

   1. ## **Submit Deposit** {#submit-deposit}

      1. #### Submit Deposit API

   **Integration URL**

   **Production** : https://mapi.flypay.site/api/Deposit/SubmitDeposit

   **Post Method** : Json Post (Content-Type: application/json)

   

      2. #### Request Parameter

| Parameter | Data Type | Required | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| MerchantCode | string | Mandatory | Merchant Account Code Sample Value: INR00001 |
| Data | string | Mandatory | Encrypted Deposit Information Refer [Form Encrypted Data (AES)](#form-encrypted-data-\(aes\)) |
| Signature | string | Mandatory | Signature for security purpose (RSA) Refer [Form Signature (RSA SHA-1)](#rsa-method) |
| Version | int | Mandatory | Api Version Sample Value: 0 |

Sample Parameter:  
{  
"merchantCode": "INR00001",  
"data": "бjNMKXuxb3/2fTf1rjrPrTMBUnsakfopRGAv50MRZpdys6rY5zAMi3bN2Wj0Lbfr8V8XwpcP+ZaNRYGL+mOMXuhPqf4EA7B1PREг4A02YEyBULjtudSI2apDHsZ+s/NHb6wT4/z1KIIABg==",  
"signature": "V49YGdaJp+rpWV5yoAZjWXPr1mgf917f15m7iXFfwOPVO0WXMOM/hUz1V+IdepY1/iU1Moq5AXcEXY@eUrIv6BPZtsCR52ZYA4yXJLU5v6JF76+BOGrXvsIq3SjJ49XcWMyy5YEwoz7KsdVmmJC31802bHjJzn1LY7D9YZs30n0=",  
"version": 0  
}

3. #### Data Parameter

| Parameter | Data Type | Required | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| MerchantCode | string | Mandatory | Merchant Account Code Sample Value: INR00001 |
| MerchantTransactionId | string | Mandatory | Merchant Transaction ID Sample Value: 20230525033836 |
| MerchantClientId | string | Mandatory | Merchant Client ID Can pass dummy value  |
| CurrencyCode | string | Mandatory | Currency for Deposit Sample Value: MYR |
| Amount | decimal | Mandatory | Amount for Deposit 2 decimal places Sample Value: 100.00 |
| SourceClientBankCode | string | Conditional | The client bank that use for Deposit Sample Value: MMBB Refer [Bank Appendix](#heading=h.3dy6vkm) ***\* If the SourceClientBankCode is EMPTY, a bank selection option will appear on cashier page for client to choose from*** |
| NotifyUrl | string | Mandatory | Server callback URL |
| ReturnUrl | string | Mandatory | Client redirect URL |
| IPAddress | string | Mandatory | Client IP Sample Value: 192.168.0.1 |
| PaymentMethodCode | string | Mandatory | The Payment Method that clients use for Deposit. Sample Value: OB Refer [Payment Method Appendix](#payment-method-appendix) |
| AccountHolderName | string | optional | Depositor Name |

###### 

   ###### 

   4. #### Response Parameter

      1. ### Bad Request Response (400)

| Parameter | Data Type | Required | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| isSuccess | bool | Mandatory | The result of Deposit. Sample Value: true |
| successCode | int | Mandatory | Status code Sample Value: 200 |
| errorMessage | string | Conditional | General Exception |
| errorList | List of Model \-ErrorCode \-ErrorDescription | Conditional | Validation Fail Code List Refer [Error Appendix](#error-appendix) |
| data | Result Model | Mandatory | The result of Deposit |
| **data Parameter** |  |  |  |
| transactionId | string | Mandatory | FlyPay Deposit ID |
| url | string | Mandatory | The direction url to FlyPay Cashier Page. ***\*Remark: Merchant can always redirect to url even if validation fails. FlyPay Cashier Page support display Error Page.*** |
| bankCode | string | Conditional | Receiving Bank Code |
| accountNumber | string | Conditional | Receiving Account Number |
| accountHolderName | string | Conditional | Receiving Account Holder Name |
| referenceNo | string | Conditional | Receiving Reference No ***\*Remark: When performing Bank/E-wallet deposit, Members must key in reference no.*** |
| qrCode | string | Conditional | Receiving QR Code (base64 image) |
| depositActualAmount | decimal | Mandatory | Receiving Deposit Amount |
| deepLink | string | Conditional | For UPI only |

### ***\*Remark :bankCode/accountNumber/accountHolderName/referenceNo/qrCode is null or empty, kindly redirect url.*** 

Sample Response Parameter:  
{  
   "isSuccess": true,  
   "successCode": 200,  
   "errorCode": "",  
   "errorMessage": "",  
   "errorList": null,  
   "data": {  
   "transactionId": "D2023111111111111",  
   "url": "https://cashier.flypay.site/Deposit/DepositCashier/?a=PeJ9TCBRWTGapY8QDQg7UMh69",  
   "bankCode": null,  
   "accountNumber": "01111111",  
   "accountHolderName": "TEST",  
   "referenceNo": "920111",  
   "qrCode": "data:ImageXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",  
   "depositActualAmount" : 500.00,  
   "deepLink" : "upi://pay?pa=1111111111@hdfcbank\&pn=ABC\&tn=NLYI\&am=1500\&cu=MYR"  
   }  
}

2. ## **Deposit Callback** {#deposit-callback}

   1. #### Deposit Callback Response

   **Post Method** : Json Post (Content-Type: application/json)

   Response “success” to stop FlyPay Callback.

   

      2. #### Callback Parameter

| Parameter | Data Type | Required | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| TransactionId | string | Mandatory | FlyPay Deposit ID Sample Value: D2023042600000093 |
| MerchantTransactionId | string | Mandatory | Merchant Transaction ID Sample Value: 20230426151826 |
| Data | string | Mandatory | Encrypted Deposit Information Refer [Decrypt Encrypted Data (AES)](#rsa-method) |
| AdditionalInformationData | string | Mandatory | Encrypted Withdrawal Additional Information Refer [Decrypt Encrypted Data (AES)](#rsa-method) |
| Signature | string  | Mandatory | Signature for security purpose (RSA) Refer [Verify Signature (RSA SHA-1)](#verify-signature-\(rsa-sha-1\)) |
| Version | int | Mandatory | Api Version Sample Value: 0 |

#### 

Sample Parameter:  
{  
   "isSuccess": true,  
   "successCode": 200,  
   "errorCode": "",  
   "errorMessage": "",  
   "errorList": null,  
   "data": {  
   "transactionId": "D2023111111111111",  
   "url": "https://cashier.flypay.site/Deposit/DepositCashier/?a=PeJ9TCBRWTGapY8QDQg7UMh69",  
   "bankCode": null,  
   "accountNumber": "01111111",  
   "accountHolderName": "TEST",  
   "referenceNo": "920111",  
   "qrCode": "data:ImageXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",  
   "depositActualAmount" : 500.00,  
   "deepLink" : "upi://pay?pa=1111111111@hdfcbank\&pn=ABC\&tn=NLYI\&am=1500\&cu=MYR"  
}

3. #### Data Parameter

   

| Parameter | Data Type | Required | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| MerchantCode | string | Mandatory | Merchant Account Code Sample Value: INR00001 |
| CurrencyCode | string | Mandatory | Currency for Deposit Sample Value: MYR |
| MerchantTransactionId | string | Mandatory | Merchant Transaction ID Sample Value: 20230426151826 |
| Status | int | Mandatory | Deposit Status Refer [Deposit Status](#deposit-status) |
| Amount | decimal | Mandatory | Amount for Deposit 2 decimal places Sample Value: 100.00 |
| NetAmount | decimal | Mandatory | Net Amount submitted from client |
| Remark | string | Optional | Remark |
| PaymentMethodCode | string | Mandatory | The Payment Method that clients use for Deposit |
| BankReferenceNo | string | Optional |  |
| UniqueReferenceNo | string | Optional |  |

   4. #### AdditionalInformationData Parameter

      

| Parameter | Data Type | Required | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| UPIID | string | Optional | Ignore this for MYR |
| BankAccountNumber | string | Optional | Receiving Account Number |
| BankAccountName | string | Optional | Receiving Account Holder Name |
| BankCode | string | Optional | Receiving Bank Code |

# **Encryptions Method** {#encryptions-method}

## **1.10.	   AES Method** {#1.10.-aes-method}

#### 1.10.1.	AES Encryption

plainText: pass in Json Format string.  
aesKey: pass in AES Key provided by FlyPay.

**C\# Sample Code:**  
**public string AESEncryption(string plainText, string aesKey)**  
        **{**  
            **using (var aes \= new AesCryptoServiceProvider()**  
            **{**  
                **Key \= new Rfc2898DeriveBytes(aesKey, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(aesKey)).GetBytes(256 / 8),**  
                **Mode \= CipherMode.CBC,**  
                **Padding \= PaddingMode.PKCS7**  
            **})**  
            **{**  
                **var input \= Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(plainText);**  
                **aes.GenerateIV();**  
                **var iv \= aes.IV;**  
                **using (var encrypter \= aes.CreateEncryptor(aes.Key, iv))**  
                **using (var cipherStream \= new MemoryStream())**  
                **{**  
                    **using (var tCryptoStream \= new CryptoStream(cipherStream, encrypter, CryptoStreamMode.Write))**  
                    **using (var tBinaryWriter \= new BinaryWriter(tCryptoStream))**  
                    **{**  
                        **//Prepend IV to data**  
                        **cipherStream.Write(iv, 0, iv.Length);**  
                        **tBinaryWriter.Write(input);**  
                        **tCryptoStream.FlushFinalBlock();**  
                    **}**  
                    **return Convert.ToBase64String(cipherStream.ToArray());**  
                **}**  
            **}**  
        **}**

**Java Sample Code:**  
**public string AESEncryption(String plainText, String aesKey) {**  
	**try {**  
	        **byte\[\] salt \= aesKey.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF\_8);**  
	        **byte\[\] passwordBytes \= aesKey.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF\_8);**

            **int iterationCount \= 1000;**  
	  
	        **SecretKeyFactory factory \= SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("PBKDF2WithHmacSHA1");**  
	        **PBEKeySpec spec \= new PBEKeySpec(new String(passwordBytes, StandardCharsets.UTF\_8).toCharArray(), salt, iterationCount, 256);**  
	  
	        **SecretKeySpec keySpec \= new SecretKeySpec(factory.generateSecret(spec).getEncoded(), "AES");**  
	        **Cipher cipher \= Cipher.getInstance("AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");**  
	          
	        **cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT\_MODE, keySpec);**  
	          
	        **byte\[\] input \= plainText.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF\_8);**  
	        **byte\[\] iv \= cipher.getParameters().getParameterSpec(IvParameterSpec.class).getIV();**  
	          
	        **ByteArrayOutputStream cipherStream \= new ByteArrayOutputStream();**  
	        **cipherStream.write(iv);**  
	        **byte\[\] encrypted \= cipher.doFinal(input);**  
	        **cipherStream.write(encrypted);**  
	        **return Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(cipherStream.toByteArray());**  
		**} catch (Exception e) {**  
            **e.printStackTrace();**  
            **return null;**  
        **}**  
    **}**

**PHP Sample Code:**  
**function AESEncryption(\$plainText, \$aesKey)**  
**{**  
    **\$key \= hash\_pbkdf2("sha1", \$aesKey, \$aesKey, 1000, 32, true);**  
    **\$iv \= openssl\_random\_pseudo\_bytes(16);**

    **\$encrypted\_data \= openssl\_encrypt(\$plainText, 'aes-256-cbc', \$key, OPENSSL\_RAW\_DATA, \$iv);**  
    **\$encrypted\_data \= \$iv . \$encrypted\_data;**

    **return base64\_encode(\$encrypted\_data);**  
**}**

#### 1.10.2.	AES Decryption

encryptedString\_base64:  encrypted Text string.  
aesKey: pass in AES Key provided by FlyPay.

**C\# Sample Code:**  
**public string AESDecryption(string encryptedString\_base64, string aesKey)**  
        **{**  
            **using (var aes \= new AesCryptoServiceProvider()**  
            **{**  
                **Key \= new Rfc2898DeriveBytes(aesKey, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(aesKey)).GetBytes(256 / 8),**  
                **Mode \= CipherMode.CBC,**  
                **Padding \= PaddingMode.PKCS7**  
            **})**  
            **{**  
                **byte\[\] cipherTextBytes \= Convert.FromBase64String(encryptedString\_base64);**  
                **//get first 16 bytes of IV and use it to decrypt**  
                **var iv \= new byte\[16\];**  
                **Array.Copy(cipherTextBytes, 0, iv, 0, iv.Length);**  
                **using (var ms \= new MemoryStream())**  
                **{**  
                    **using (var cs \= new CryptoStream(ms, aes.CreateDecryptor(aes.Key, iv), CryptoStreamMode.Write))**  
                    **using (var binaryWriter \= new BinaryWriter(cs))**  
                    **{**  
                        **//Decrypt Cipher Text from Message**  
                        **binaryWriter.Write(**  
                            **cipherTextBytes,**  
                            **iv.Length,**  
                            **cipherTextBytes.Length \- iv.Length**  
                        **);**  
                    **}**  
                    **return Encoding.UTF8.GetString(ms.ToArray());**  
                **}**  
            **}**  
        **}**

**Java Sample Code:**  
**public string AESDecryption(String encryptedStringBase64, String aesKey) {**  
    	**try {**  
	        **byte\[\] salt \= aesKey.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF\_8);**  
	        **byte\[\] passwordBytes \= aesKey.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF\_8);**

            **int iterationCount \= 1000;**  
	  
	        **SecretKeyFactory factory \= SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("PBKDF2WithHmacSHA1");**  
	        **PBEKeySpec spec \= new PBEKeySpec(new String(passwordBytes, StandardCharsets.UTF\_8).toCharArray(), salt, iterationCount, 256);**  
	  
	        **SecretKeySpec keySpec \= new SecretKeySpec(factory.generateSecret(spec).getEncoded(), "AES");**  
	        **Cipher cipher \= Cipher.getInstance("AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");**  
	          
	        **byte\[\] encryptedBytes \= Base64.getDecoder().decode(encryptedStringBase64);**  
	        **IvParameterSpec ivParameterSpec \= new IvParameterSpec(encryptedBytes, 0, 16);**  
	          
	        **cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT\_MODE, keySpec, ivParameterSpec);**  
	          
	        **byte\[\] decryptedBytes \= cipher.doFinal(encryptedBytes, 16, encryptedBytes.length \- 16);**  
	  
	        **return new String(decryptedBytes, StandardCharsets.UTF\_8);**  
    	**} catch (Exception e) {**  
            **e.printStackTrace();**  
            **return null;**  
        **}**  
    **}**

**PHP Sample Code:**  
**function AESDecryption(\$encryptedStringBase64, \$aesKey)**  
**{**  
    **\$encryptedStringBase64 \= base64\_decode(\$encryptedStringBase64);**

    **\$key \= hash\_pbkdf2("sha1", \$aesKey, \$aesKey, 1000, 32, true);**  
    **\$iv \= substr(\$encryptedStringBase64, 0, 16);**

    **\$encryptedStringBase64 \= substr(\$encryptedStringBase64, 16);**

    **\$decrypted\_data \= openssl\_decrypt(\$encryptedStringBase64, "aes-256-cbc", \$key, OPENSSL\_RAW\_DATA, \$iv);**

    **return \$decrypted\_data;**  
**}**

    13. ## **RSA Method** {#rsa-method}

        1. #### Generate Signature

plainText: pass in Json Format string.  
privateKey: pass in Private Key generated by Merchant.

> > > **C\# Sample Code:**

> > >  **public string GenerateSignatureSHA1(string plainText, string privateKey)**

> > >         **{**

> > >             **try**

> > >             **{**

> > >                 **using (RSACryptoServiceProvider rsa \= new RSACryptoServiceProvider())**

> > >                 **{**

> > >                     **// Import the private key from Base64 string (assuming it's in PKCS\#8 format)**

> > >                     **byte\[\] privateKeyBytes \= Convert.FromBase64String(privateKey);**

> > >                     **rsa.ImportPkcs8PrivateKey(privateKeyBytes, out \_);**

> > > 

> > >                     **byte\[\] data \= Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(plainText);**

> > >                     **byte\[\] signatureBytes \= rsa.SignData(data, CryptoConfig.MapNameToOID("SHA1"));**

> > > 

> > >                     **return Convert.ToBase64String(signatureBytes);**

> > >                 **}**

> > >             **}**

> > >             **catch (Exception e)**

> > >             **{**

> > >                 **Console.WriteLine(\$"Error: {e.Message}");**

> > >                 **return null;**

> > >             **}**

> > >         **}**

**Java Sample Code:**

**public String generateSignatureSHA1(String plainText, String privateKey) {**

        **try {**

            **byte\[\] keyBytes \= Base64.getDecoder().decode(privateKey);**

            **PKCS8EncodedKeySpec keySpec \= new PKCS8EncodedKeySpec(keyBytes);**

            **KeyFactory keyFactory \= KeyFactory.getInstance("RSA");**

            **PrivateKey privateKeyObj \= keyFactory.generatePrivate(keySpec);**

            **Signature signature \= Signature.getInstance("SHA1withRSA");**

            **signature.initSign(privateKeyObj);**

            **signature.update(plainText.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF\_8));**

            **byte\[\] signatureBytes \= signature.sign();**

            **return Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(signatureBytes);**

        **} catch (Exception e) {**

            **e.printStackTrace();**

            **return null;**

        **}**

    **}**

> > > **PHP Sample Code:**

> > > **function generateSignatureSHA1(\$plainText, \$privateKey)**

> > > **{**

> > >     **\$privateKey \= chunk\_split(\$privateKey, 64, "\\n");**

> > >     **\$privateKey \= "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\\n" . \$privateKey . "-----END PRIVATE KEY-----";**

> > >     **\$privateKey \= openssl\_pkey\_get\_private(\$privateKey);**

> > >     **openssl\_sign(\$plainText, \$signature, \$privateKey, OPENSSL\_ALGO\_SHA1);**

> > >     **return base64\_encode(\$signature);**

> > > **}**

2. #### Verify Signature

signature: pass in the Signature parameter return by FlyPay.  
plainText: pass in Json Format string.  
publicKey: pass in Public Key generated by FlyPay.

> > > **C\# Sample Code:**

> > > **public bool VerifySignatureSHA1(string signature, string plainText, string publicKey)**

> > >         **{**

> > >             **try**

> > >             **{**

> > >                 **using (RSACryptoServiceProvider rsa \= new RSACryptoServiceProvider())**

> > >                 **{**

> > >                     **// Import the public key from Base64 string (assuming it's in X.509 format)**

> > >                     **byte\[\] publicKeyBytes \= Convert.FromBase64String(publicKey);**

> > >                     **rsa.ImportSubjectPublicKeyInfo(publicKeyBytes, out \_);**

> > > 

> > >                     **byte\[\] data \= Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(plainText);**

> > >                     **byte\[\] signatureBytes \= Convert.FromBase64String(signature);**

> > > 

> > >                     **return rsa.VerifyData(data, CryptoConfig.MapNameToOID("SHA1"), signatureBytes);**

> > >                 **}**

> > >             **}**

> > >             **catch (Exception e)**

> > >             **{**

> > >                 **Console.WriteLine(\$"Error: {e.Message}");**

> > >                 **return false;**

> > >             **}**

> > >         **}**

> > > 

**Java Sample Code:**

**public boolean verifySignatureSHA1(String signature, String plainText, String publicKey) {**

        **try {**

            **byte\[\] keyBytes \= Base64.getDecoder().decode(publicKey);**

            **X509EncodedKeySpec keySpec \= new X509EncodedKeySpec(keyBytes);**

            **KeyFactory keyFactory \= KeyFactory.getInstance("RSA");**

            **PublicKey publicKeyObj \= keyFactory.generatePublic(keySpec);**

            **Signature verifier \= Signature.getInstance("SHA1withRSA");**

            **verifier.initVerify(publicKeyObj);**

            **verifier.update(plainText.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF\_8));**

            **byte\[\] signatureBytes \= Base64.getDecoder().decode(signature);**

            **return verifier.verify(signatureBytes);**

        **} catch (Exception e) {**

            **e.printStackTrace();**

            **return false;**

        **}**

    **}**

**PHP Sample Code:**

**function verifySignatureSHA1(\$signature, \$plainText, \$publicKey)**

**{**

    **\$publicKey \= chunk\_split(\$publicKey, 64, "\\n");**

    **\$publicKey \= "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----\\n" . \$publicKey . "-----END PUBLIC KEY-----";**

	**\$publicKey \= openssl\_pkey\_get\_public(\$publicKey);**

    **\$signature \= base64\_decode(\$signature);**

    **return openssl\_verify(\$plainText, \$signature, \$publicKey, OPENSSL\_ALGO\_SHA1);**

**}**  
> > >
